title: solenostemon latifolius
intro: Solenostemon latifolius, commonly known as Coleus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae, native to tropical Africa. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The health benefits of Coleus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Coleus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
